description: This file defines the templating context and utility functions for SQL Lab in Apache Superset, including classes and functions for handling Jinja templates, dataset macros, and user context.

classes.name: UndefinedTemplateFunctionException
classes.description: Exception raised when an undefined function-like Jinja identifier is encountered.

classes.name: TimeFilter
classes.description: Container class for temporal filter expressions.

classes.name: ExtraCache
classes.description: Class for managing additional cache keys and user-related context for query caching.

classes.name: WhereInMacro
classes.description: Class for generating SQL IN clause strings from a list of values.

classes.name: BaseTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Base class for database-specific Jinja template processing, managing context and rendering.

classes.name: JinjaTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Subclass implementing Jinja template processing with error handling and context setup.

classes.name: NoOpTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Template processor that returns the input SQL string unchanged.

classes.name: PrestoTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Presto-specific Jinja context with methods for partition info.

classes.name: HiveTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Hive-specific template processor, inherits from PrestoTemplateProcessor.

classes.name: SparkTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Spark-specific template processor, inherits from HiveTemplateProcessor.

classes.name: TrinoTemplateProcessor
classes.description: Trino-specific Jinja context, inherits from PrestoTemplateProcessor.

methods.name: context_addons
methods.description: Returns additional context variables for Jinja templates from app config.

methods.name: safe_proxy
methods.description: Wraps a function call, ensuring return type safety and JSON serialization for collections.

methods.name: validate_context_types
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes context variables for safe template rendering.

methods.name: validate_template_context
methods.description: Validates the template context, including engine-specific subcontexts.

methods.name: to_datetime
methods.description: Parses a string into a datetime object with a specified format.

methods.name: dataset_macro
methods.description: Generates SQL for a dataset given its ID, including optional metrics and filters.

methods.name: get_dataset_id_from_context
methods.description: Extracts dataset ID from request context or URL parameters.

methods.name: metric_macro
methods.description: Returns the SQL expression for a specified metric, resolving dataset context.
